spanish: y acercará sobre hijo del ganado minjá, sólet, tres décimas amasada en el aceite, mitad del hin;

findings.issue: minjá leaves the common noun מִנְחָה untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish.
sólet leaves the common noun סֹלֶת untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish.
amasada specifies kneading and is feminine; the qal passive participle of בלל is masculine singular and licenses mixed.
en selects the in-sense of ב, which also licenses with; meaning is not otherwise changed.

notes: acercará keeps hiphil 3ms, and sobre, hijo del ganado, tres décimas, mitad del hin stay inside the tokens.
